name: B10-0373/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Gaza at breaking point: EU action to combat famine and the urgent need to release hostages and move towards a two-state solution
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Gaza at breaking point: EU action to combat famine, the urgent need to release hostages and move towards a two-state solution
part_text:
This is a resolution, so it does not change any law. It sets out what the European Parliament wants the European Union to do about Gaza. It asks for an immediate and permanent ceasefire, the release of all hostages, and the withdrawal of Israeli forces from Gaza and the occupied territories. It also asks the European Union to suspend its trade agreement with Israel, stop arms sales to Israel, and recognise a Palestinian state.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament is only stating demands; European Union governments and the Commission must act.
- **Who it affects:** Israel, the Palestinian territories, European Union countries and companies trading with or selling arms to Israel.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to European Union institutions and governments. Whether any demand becomes real depends on them.
